inspiration.panelSubtitle: Turn fragment ideas into a complete story framework
inspiration.inputScope: Best for short inspirations / synopses / snippet ideas (a few sentences to one or two paragraphs). To extract settings from entire chapters / full books, use "Document parsing / Import project reference" for more complete results.
inspiration.inputPlaceholder:
Jot anything down...

For example:
- A retired soldier searching for his missing sister in post-apocalyptic ruins
- In an ancient court, a substitute princess uncovers the emperor's secret
- Cyberpunk + cultivation, a programmer who cultivates with code
- Or just a few keywords: deep sea, deserted island, amnesia, monster
